business_summary: Daiko Tsusan Co.,Ltd. operates as a trading company in the fields of CATV and information and communications in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in manufacturing, selling, leasing, and rental of cable television and information communication cables, materials, equipment and accessories, and tools and measuring equipment; and office automation equipment and software. It also offers consulting, design and construction, and maintenance services related to cable television and information and communication. Daiko Tsusan Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.
